description: To the payload corresponding JSON schema file is `oAuth2RefreshToken.json`

grant_type.description: OAuth 2.0 **grant_type** `refresh_token`, to refresh an access token

refresh_token.description: same token as it was generated from the token endpoint as part of the last access token request call (as a note, in this API the `refresh_token` is a mandatory response token, in RFC 6749 it is an optional response token)
